key_points: Google signed a 20-year nuclear power deal with Constellation Energy to supply AI data centers, securing long‑term clean energy for its AI build‑out.
A securities fraud class action was filed after AI‑related issues were disclosed, prompting a ~4% intraday drop in GOOGL.
Reports indicate two AI experts moved to Anthropic, though CEO Sundar Pichai and analysts downplayed the talent‑loss concerns.
Google is reportedly developing a next‑generation AI chip in partnership with MediaTek, potentially strengthening its hardware stack.
Several outlets note GOOGL trades at a discount to fair value, and analyst price‑target updates remain broadly neutral‑to‑positive.
